fields.description:
Observed 2026-09-10 in a Copilot CLI session on the rebar checkout: the configured rebar MCP server is absent from the session's available tools; the client surfaces 'MCP server rebar requires authentication. Use /mcp auth rebar to connect.' The agent only discovers the degradation indirectly (missing tools) and falls back to the local rebar CLI carve-out for all tracker ops, which works but bypasses the MCP routing policy in AGENTS.md (certified ops signed under the box's trusted signing environment, async gate starters, de-dup protection) and makes every tracker op slower. Impact: tracker writes/gates from Copilot sessions are un-certified relative to the on-box MCP path; if opcert environment enforcement (verify.require_environment + verify.opcert_enforce_since) is ever flipped on per ADR 0104, these sessions' gate ops would stop being acceptable.

## Root cause (reproduced 2026-11-02, Copilot CLI 1.0.105, non-interactive `copilot -p`)

The workspace `.mcp.json` sends `Authorization: Bearer ${MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI}`. Copilot CLI connects and calls rebar tools when that variable is set. When it is unset, Copilot sends an empty bearer, the server answers HTTP 401 with an OAuth `WWW-Authenticate` challenge, and Copilot reports "Browser-based OAuth required" / `/mcp auth rebar` (Copilot debug log, `rmcp::transport::worker` OAuthChallenge status_code 401). The variable reached only interactive zsh: `~/.zshrc` sources `~/.config/rebar/mcp-pats.env`, but zsh does not read `~/.zshrc` for non-interactive shells, and the launchd copy published by `~/bin/refresh-mcp-pats.sh` was empty (it does not survive the 2026-10-28 reboot). docs/mcp-client-setup.md recommended `~/.zshrc`.

## Fix

- Host (done 2026-11-02): `~/.zshenv` sources `~/.config/rebar/mcp-pats.env`; launchd values republished from that file.
- Repo: docs/mcp-client-setup.md recommends `~/.zshenv` and names the 401 / `/mcp auth rebar` symptom of a non-interactive shell.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Root cause recorded on this ticket: empty bearer from non-interactive shells, reproduced with the variable unset (401 OAuth challenge) and set (tool call succeeds).
- [ ] A Copilot CLI session started from a clean environment (`env -i` zsh -c, no inherited variables) lists the rebar MCP tools and completes one `show_ticket` read and one `comment_ticket` write on this ticket through MCP.
- [ ] docs/mcp-client-setup.md recommends `~/.zshenv` for zsh and names the non-interactive-shell symptom; checked by `grep -n "zshenv" docs/mcp-client-setup.md` on origin/main after merge.
- [ ] The change merges through Gerrit at LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
